name: Shuriken Training
description:
You are trained in the use of shuriken (small throwing blades), a special weapon type. Making an attack with shuriken costs a half action instead of an action.

Describe your technique.

improvements.name: Long Throw
improvements.description: When you attack with shuriken, you may spend an additional half action to double the weapon's range without the normal ill-favored penalty.

improvements.name: Pinning Throw
improvements.description: Each time you roll the maximum possible result on a damage die for your shuriken, if the creature you're attacking is adjacent to a wall or other sturdy, inanimate object, they are pinned to that object and must spend a half action on their turn to free themself (multiple pinnings require multiple half actions).

improvements.name: Piercing Throw
improvements.description: Each time you roll the maximum possible result on a damage die for your shuriken, you inflict 1 injury on the creature.
